We need to fix compilation errors. The errors are due to missing Mockito imports. Likely the test environment does not have Mockito dependency. We can remove Mockito usage and replace with manual stubs or simple implementations.

Simplify: Instead of using @Mock and Mockito, we can create a simple implementation of OutputFormat that records calls.

Define interface OutputFormat<T> (exists in library). We can create a simple class implements OutputFormat<T> with apply method returning predetermined value.

But we need to test behavior of JsonSchema.validate with format. We can just call schema.validate(node, format) where format is our custom implementation that returns a value. No need for mocking verification of arguments. So we can replace each test to use a custom OutputFormat that records messages passed.

We also need to remove Mockito imports and annotations.

Also need ExecutionContextCustomizer interface; we can implement lambda.

Thus rewrite test class without Mockito.

We'll need to import com.networknt.schema.OutputFormat, ExecutionContextCustomizer, ValidationMessage.

Check library: OutputFormat<T> is functional interface with method T apply(Set<ValidationMessage> messages). We'll implement.

Implement a simple class TestOutputFormat<T> implements OutputFormat<T> { private final T result; private Set<ValidationMessage> captured; public TestOutputFormat(T result){this.result=result;} public T apply(Set<ValidationMessage> messages){this.captured=messages; return result;} public Set<ValidationMessage> getCaptured(){return captured;} }

Then in tests we can assert result and captured messages.

Rewrite each test accordingly.

Also need import for Set, etc.

Remove duplicate imports.

Also need ExecutionContextCustomizer functional interface; we can use lambda (executionContext) -> { customizerCalled[0]=true; };

Now adjust test methods signatures: no @Mock parameter, just create format inside.

Implement.
